dataset.title: Integrated Transcriptome and Proteome Analyses Reveal Organ-Specific Proteome Deterioration in Old Rats

findings.message: The bundle holds 1.45377e+06 where the producer reported 1.45382e+06 (results.txt: All target PSMs with q-value <= 0.01 (pxreprise:DEF-PSM-1PCT v1)). Both numbers are kept; treat the producer's as canonical until the difference is explained.

Of 32580 occupancy entries MetaMorpheus wrote, some are not in ptm_stoichiometry: 32471 sample has no single run (several files, or a file that is not a run). 'site not in ptm_sites' means the entry's site has no ptm_sites row to key on; 'not determinable' means a cell's segments could not be assigned to its accessions from the sequences (QuantProject DEF-OCC-ACCESSION), which is never guessed. Absence of a row for these sites is therefore not NA. A 'duplicate' is a second entry for a (site, run) that already has a row: one with identical values loses nothing; one with DIFFERENT values means MetaMorpheus wrote two answers and the first in file order was stored (examples in bundle.json occupancy.differing_duplicates; which one should be stored is QuantProject's to define).

The protein-group table is labelled by sample through the search's ExperimentalDesign.tsv, and 48 sample(s) have no single run: CYT_BO_1 (2 files (fractions or technical replicates), summed into one value); CYT_BO_2 (2 files (fractions or technical replicates), summed into one value); CYT_BO_3 (2 files (fractions or technical replicates), summed into one value); CYT_BY_1 (2 files (fractions or technical replicates), summed into one value); CYT_BY_2 (2 files (fractions or technical replicates), summed into one value); CYT_BY_3 (2 files (fractions or technical replicates), summed into one value); CYT_LO_1 (2 files (fractions or technical replicates), summed into one value); CYT_LO_2 (2 files (fractions or technical replicates), summed into one value); CYT_LO_3 (2 files (fractions or technical replicates), summed into one value); CYT_LY_1 (2 files (fractions or technical replicates), summed into one value); and 38 more. A stored quantity belongs to one assay (one run), and a sample's value belongs to none, so it is never split onto runs: 712129 protein-group value(s) (intensity and spectral count) of these samples are not stored, nor is their PTM site occupancy. Peptide quantities are per file and are stored. A missing protein-group quantity for these samples therefore means 'not stored', not 'not measured'. The design is in this bundle's sources.

The SDRF was used only for the runs it names that were searched: it names 48 file(s) the search did not use, whose rows were not used: AO-B019, AO-B025, AO-B026, AO-B028, AO-B030, AO-B033, AO-B036, AO-B039, AO-B041, AO-B042 ...; it names no row for 51 searched run(s), each given a synthetic sample with no annotation: AO-A764, AO-A767, AO-A771, AO-A772, AO-A774, AO-A776_130427001346, AO-A777, AO-A780, AO-A782, AO-A783 .... sdrf_status is `partial`.

The deposited SDRF describes its samples only as text with no ontology term, so the curated organism part, cell type, disease and individual columns are empty. The text is in sample_characteristics: organism part: liver. Match on it as text; it has not been mapped to a term.

Some modifications on peptides shared between proteins were not written to ptm_sites for one or more of those proteins, because the peptide could not be located in that protein's sequence and the producer's residue spans cannot be paired with its accessions. Of the (PSM, protein) pairs affected: 2370 named a protein that does not contain the stored peptide -- typically a PSM ambiguous between peptide sequences (level 4 or 5), where this protein carries a different candidate than the first, which is the one stored. Sites on the other proteins of the same PSMs are written. Counts are in bundle.json under protein_databases.

2 modification(s) could not be mapped to a UNIMOD accession or a mass, and are carried in ProForma as [Info:...] tags: Common Biological:Hydroxybutyrylation on K, UniProt:S-(2,3-dicarboxypropyl)cysteine on C. Their ptm_sites rows exist and carry modification_name, with modification null, so a query by name finds them and a query by UNIMOD accession will not.

The producer wrote some rows more than once, identical in every column, and the copies were dropped so each identifier appears once. Nothing was lost: the kept row is byte-for-byte what the duplicates said. Rows that share an identifier and disagree anywhere are still refused rather than collapsed. protein_groups: 1 identifier(s), 1 row(s) dropped, e.g. PXD002467:A0ABK0LI91;Q9EQC9 written 2 times. The full list is in bundle.json under collapsed_duplicates.
109 occupancy entries on decoy protein groups were not stored: MetaMorpheus computes them, and they are FDR machinery, not biology.

dataset.summary: PXD002467 is a DDA label-free dataset (Rattus norvegicus) with 96 runs, 96 samples and no enrichment step (whole proteome). It was reanalysed with MetaMorpheus 1.1.12. At 1% FDR the search reports 1,453,769 PSMs, 44,050 peptidoforms and 6,747 protein groups, and the repository holds 29,726 PTM sites for it. 8 open warnings about it are recorded.

organisms_are: `organisms` is the organism of the protein DATABASE the search used, not a statement about the samples. Sample annotation, where any exists, is in the catalog's `samples` and `sample_characteristics` tables.
